notes: The ASV reorders the two sharpened/furbished clauses ahead of their purpose phrases; the units are aligned to the Hebrew morphemes regardless of order (rule 25).
The verse's alternative rendering note offers a different construal of מֹאֶסֶת כָּל־עֵץ; the alignment follows the ASV text as printed.

No interrogative morpheme stands in the נָשִׂישׂ clause, so the fronted *shall* is correctly the verb's own under rule 17's first limit, and אוֹ takes the connective *then* off the ASV under rule 14. Both לָהּ morphemes are unrepresented because the recasting *that it may be as lightning* leaves nothing for either, the *it* at t014 being the infinitive's supplied subject under rule 52.
